C1088.title: Guangdong Yangjiang Man Sentenced to 4 Years for Helping Telecom Fraudsters Recruit Victims, Earning Only 165 Yuan
C1088.summary: In March 2023, the defendant Zhong pulled victim Liu into a WeChat group, after which Liu was defrauded of over 750,000 yuan through a fake online task scam. Zhong illegally earned only 165 yuan. The court found that Zhong knowingly assisted others in committing fraud, constituting the crime of fraud, and sentenced him to 4 years in prison.

references.title: Man in Yangjiang, Guangdong, helps scammers 'recruit' people, earns 165 yuan, gets 4-year sentence, expert analysis
